title: Daily digest: Pakistan military says it killed 22 mili | Harish Rao demands scrapping of Kukatpal | Nalgonda DCC Chief Dares Rajagopal to Qu | SCoR Cancels 22 Trains, Reschedules 22 A | Court cancels AAP councillor's election
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Telangana Today / Deccan Chronicle / India Today
bullets_en: Pakistan military says it killed 22 militants in raids on hideouts.
Harish Rao demands scrapping of Kukatpally truck parking land’s auction.
Nalgonda DCC Chief Dares Rajagopal to Quit Congress.
SCoR Cancels 22 Trains, Reschedules 22 Amid Cyclone Alert.
Court cancels AAP councillor's election in Delhi, declares BJP runnerup winner.
bullets_ur: Pakistan military ne kaha ke usne chhupe thikanon par chhapon ke dauran 22 militant hal kar diye.
Harish Rao ne Kukatpally truck parking ki zameen ki boli mansookh karne ka mutalba kiya.
Nalgonda DCC Chief ne Rajagopal ko Congress chhorne ka chailenge de diya.
SCoR ne cyclone alert ke baad 22 trainen mansookh aur 22 ka schedule tabdeel kar diya.
Adalat ne Delhi mein AAP councillor ka intikhab mansookh kar ke BJP runnerup ko jeeta qarar de diya.
